extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store listing and in chrome://extensions.

extDescription.message: Open X, Bluesky and Threads post detail in a side column instead of navigating away.

options.title: side-view · settings
options.brandTagline: Your timeline. A little more room.
options.heading: Settings
options.subtitle: Make room for the way you read.
options.statusDefault: Preferences sync with your browser account.
options.statusLoadFailed: Reopen this page to try again. Your saved preferences haven’t changed.
options.saveError: Couldn’t save this change. Please try again.

general.title: General
general.subtitle: Stay in your timeline while you explore.
general.enableHint: Open details beside your timeline. Reload X or Bluesky after changing this setting; Threads updates live.
general.interceptHint: Include these links in the detail column. Turn off to open only posts.

layout.title: Layout
layout.subtitle: For X and Bluesky. Threads manages its own columns.
layout.replaceSidebarHint: Give the right sidebar to the detail view.
layout.insertColumnHint: Add a detail column beside the sidebar.
layout.widthError: Enter a whole number from 320 to 1200.
layout.compactHint: Keep the left navigation as a slim icon rail, even after closing a detail.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.subtitle: One reading habit, three different homes.
platforms.xBlueskyNote: Use the layout and navigation preferences above. Changes apply live, except the main enable switch.
platforms.threadsNote: Reuses one native column saved to your Threads account. Manage its width, order and scrolling in Threads. To remove it, use the native column menu; disabling side-view won’t delete it.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.subtitle: For troubleshooting changes to X’s page structure.
advanced.overridesHint: A JSON object mapping selector keys to CSS selectors. Leave it empty to use built-in selectors. Reload X after saving.
advanced.overridesError: Use a JSON object with selector names and CSS selectors.
advanced.overridesErrorNotString: “$1” must contain a CSS selector string.
advanced.overridesErrorInvalidSelector: “$1” is not a valid CSS selector.
advanced.overridesErrorFallback: Check your JSON and try again.
